## What's new
- **Paid subscriptions goal** for YouTube and Kick. Pick the metric **Paid subscriptions**:
  - **YouTube:** channel memberships.
  - **Kick:** paid subscriptions.
  - Each new one, each renewal and each gifted one adds 1 (a gift of 5 adds 5).
  - YouTube and Kick don't publish a total of paid subscribers, so they are counted from the live chat while OBS is open, like comments and bits. The goal starts at 0; set **Current value** to start from your current number.
- **On Twitch** nothing changes: **Subscribers** was already the paid total, read from Twitch's API. Followers are the free ones. On YouTube, **Subscribers** are the free ones.

## Fixed
- **Chat goals on quiet channels stay connected.** When the Twitch or Kick chat goes quiet, AC Goal Bar now pings the server (after 4 minutes on Twitch, 1 minute on Kick) and reconnects if there is no answer, instead of possibly waiting forever on a dead connection.

## Updating
From 0.1.1 on, AC Goal Bar offers this update automatically (or use **Tools → AC Goal Bar: Check for updates**). From 0.1.0, replace the plugin folder by hand once.

## Downloads
| Platform | File | Install to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon, 13+) | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.7-macos-arm64.zip` | `~/Library/Application Support/obs-studio/plugins/` |
| Windows x64 | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.7-windows-x64.zip` | `C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\` |
| Linux x86_64 | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.7-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `~/.config/obs-studio/plugins/` |

The macOS bundle is ad-hoc signed; if macOS blocks it, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine` on the installed `.plugin` (see README).

All three packages are built and unit-tested in CI from the same commit.
